route1.blocked_message: You must defeat your rival blocking the path ahead first!

route21.blocked_message: The open sea south of Pallet is too rough to cross without a Pokemon that knows Surf. (Requires the Soul Badge)

route1.name: Route 1
route1.description: A quiet path connecting Pallet Town and Viridian City.

viridian_city_gym.blocked_message: The gym doors are locked tight. You need 7 Gym Badges to enter!

viridian_city_gym.name: Viridian City Gym
viridian_city_gym.description: The final mysterious gym of Kanto, operated by Giovanni.

route22.name: Route 22
route22.description: A winding path leading toward the Pokémon League reception gate.

route23.blocked_message: The water north of here is too rough to cross without a Pokemon that knows Surf. (Requires the Soul Badge)

route2_south.name: Route 2 - South
route2_south.description: A grassy route bridging Viridian City and Pewter City, split by Viridian Forest.

viridian_forest.name: Viridian Forest
viridian_forest.description: A deep, natural maze filled with towering trees and bug Pokémon.

route2_north.blocked_message: You must defeat the trainers blocking the path ahead first!

route2_north.name: Route 2 - North
route2_north.description: A grassy route bridging Viridian City and Pewter City, split by Viridian Forest.

pewter_city.name: Pewter City
pewter_city.description: A stone gray town where history and gray stones sleep.

route3.blocked_message: You must defeat Gym Leader Brock and earn the Boulder Badge before leaving Pewter City!

pewter_city_gym.name: Pewter City Gym
pewter_city_gym.description: A rugged gym specializing in rock-type Pokémon.

pewter_museum_of_science.name: Pewter Museum of Science
pewter_museum_of_science.description: A fascinating museum showcasing ancient fossils and space exhibits.

pewter_city.blocked_message: You should check out the fossil exhibits before leaving!

route3.name: Route 3
route3.description: A rocky, uneven path leading up toward Mt. Moon.

mt_moon_1f.name: Mt. Moon - 1F
mt_moon_1f.description: The cavernous entrance level of Mt. Moon, filled with wild Zubat and rock formations.

mt_moon_b1f.name: Mt. Moon - B1F
mt_moon_b1f.description: A deeper, darker subterranean level where rare fossils and Team Rocket lurk.

route4.blocked_message: You must defeat the guardian blocking the exit cave!

route4.name: Route 4
route4.description: A rocky path descending from Mt. Moon toward Cerulean City, featuring a Pokémon Center near the cave exit.

cerulean_city.name: Cerulean City
cerulean_city.description: A mysterious, blue aura surrounds this watery city of central Kanto.

route24.blocked_message: An old friend is blocking the path. Defeat him to continue on your journey!

route5.blocked_message: The police officer is guarding the route south. You need the Cascade Badge to pass!

route9.blocked_message: A small tree blocks your path. You need the HM for Cut to pass!

cerulean_city_gym.blocked_message: The door is locked! The Gym Leader will hopefully be back soon...

cerulean_city_gym.name: Cerulean City Gym
cerulean_city_gym.description: An indoor pool gym specializing in graceful water-type Pokémon, led by Misty.

route24.name: Route 24 (Nugget Bridge)
route24.description: A scenic northern route featuring the infamous Nugget Bridge challenge.

route25.blocked_message: You must prove yourself against the Nugget Bridge challengers and Team Rocket first!

cerulean_cave_1f.blocked_message: A strange, powerful aura radiates from the cave mouth. You should become Champion before entering.

route25.name: Route 25
route25.description: A windy cape stretching eastward to the edge of the continent.

bills_cottage.name: Bill's Cottage
bills_cottage.description: A cozy seaside home belonging to Kanto's eccentric Pokémon maniac, Bill.

cerulean_cave_1f.name: Cerulean Cave - 1F
cerulean_cave_1f.description: A mysterious, high-level cave filled with powerful and rare Pokémon.

cerulean_cave_b1f.name: Cerulean Cave - B1F
cerulean_cave_b1f.description: The upper chamber of the mysterious cavern.

cerulean_cave_b2f.name: Cerulean Cave - B2F
cerulean_cave_b2f.description: The deepest, darkest basement of the cave where the ultimate genetic Pokémon dwells.

explore_table.intro: A powerful psychic presence overwhelms you... MEWTWO blocks your path!

route5.name: Route 5
route5.description: A rolling green route heading south toward Saffron City, featuring the Day Care.

saffron_city.blocked_message: A thirsty guard blocks the SAFFRON gatehouse! (Give him a Fresh Water, Soda Pop, or Lemonade.)

underground_path_north_south.name: Underground Path (Routes 5-6)
underground_path_north_south.description: A heavily lit, secure pedestrian tunnel passing safely beneath Saffron City.

route6.name: Route 6
route6.description: A lush route leading southward from the Underground Path straight into Vermilion City.

saffron_city.blocked_message: A thirsty guard blocks the SAFFRON gatehouse! (Give him a Fresh Water, Soda Pop, or Lemonade.)

vermilion_city.name: Vermilion City
vermilion_city.description: The port of exquisite sunsets where maritime dreams dock.

vermilion_city_gym.blocked_message: A small tree blocks the Gym entrance. It looks like it could be CUT down...

vermilion_city_gym.name: Vermilion City Gym
vermilion_city_gym.description: An electric shock-themed gym filled with locked electronic door vaults, led by Lt. Surge.

pokemon_fan_club.name: Pokémon Fan Club
pokemon_fan_club.description: A cozy clubhouse where passionate trainers gather to show off and talk about their favorite Pokémon.

diglett_cave.name: Diglett's Cave
diglett_cave.description: A long underground tunnel entirely carved out by speedy Diglett, linking Vermilion City to Route 2.

ss_anne.name: S.S. Anne
ss_anne.description: A luxurious cruise liner docked at Vermilion harbor. Passengers and sailors mingle on the sunlit main deck.

ss_anne_deck.name: S.S. Anne Deck
ss_anne_deck.description: The ship's lower decks: passenger cabins, the galley, and crew quarters humming with activity.

ss_anne_captain.blocked_message: Your rival blocks the stairway to the captain's cabin! Defeat him to get through!

ss_anne_captain.name: Captain's Cabin
ss_anne_captain.description: The captain's private quarters at the heart of the S.S. Anne. The old captain looks rather green...

vermilion_dock.name: Vermilion City Dock
vermilion_dock.description: The harbor dock where the S.S. Anne was moored. Only calm water and wheeling gulls remain.

ss_anne.blocked_message: The sailor blocks the gangway. You need an S.S. Ticket to board the S.S. Anne!
ss_anne.departed_message: The S.S. Anne has departed! Only calm water remains where the great ship was moored.

route9.name: Route 9
route9.description: A rocky route east of Cerulean City, winding past ledges toward Route 10. Trainers lurk around every bend.

route10.name: Route 10
route10.description: A north-south route split by a river. North lie Rock Tunnel and the abandoned Power Plant; south, Lavender Town.

power_plant.blocked_message: A wide, fast river separates you from the Power Plant. You'd need to Surf across it — Koga of the Fuchsia Gym is said to hold that HM.

route11.name: Route 11
route11.description: A busy east-west route from Vermilion City. Diglett's Cave opens nearby, and a gatehouse leads east toward Route 12.

route12.blocked_message: A huge sleeping Snorlax blocks the path! It won't budge...

route12.name: Route 12
route12.description: Silence Bridge stretches over the water. A huge Pokémon sleeps by the northern gate, and the only tall grass grows behind dense, cuttable trees.

explore_table.intro: The awakened Snorlax lumbers toward you, ready to battle!

power_plant.name: Power Plant
power_plant.description: An abandoned power plant east of Route 10, humming with Electric-type Pokémon. Something powerful nests near the exit...

explore_table.intro: A legendary bird crackling with electricity blocks your path... ZAPDOS!

rock_tunnel_1f.name: Rock Tunnel 1F
rock_tunnel_1f.description: A pitch-dark tunnel bored through solid rock between Cerulean and Lavender. Without a light, every footstep echoes into the black.

rock_tunnel_b1f.blocked_message: Two burly Hikers block the tunnel mouth, spoiling for a fight! (Defeat the Hikers in the west tunnel to pass.)

rock_tunnel_b1f.name: Rock Tunnel B1F
rock_tunnel_b1f.description: The lower floor of Rock Tunnel. The air is cooler here, and the darkness feels heavier — but a faint draft hints at the Lavender exit.

lavender_town.blocked_message: Two Hikers are having a shouting match in the tunnel ahead, and neither will let anyone squeeze past! (Defeat the Hikers in the northeast tunnel to pass.)

lavender_town.name: Lavender Town
lavender_town.description: LAVENDER TOWN — The Noble Purple Town. A hushed little town watched over by the towering POKéMON TOWER, where departed Pokémon are laid to rest.

pokemon_tower_1f.name: Pokémon Tower 1F
pokemon_tower_1f.description: The entrance hall of Pokémon Tower. Candles flicker before rows of memorial tablets, and the air smells of incense. Mourners come and go in silence.

pokemon_tower_2f.name: Pokémon Tower 2F
pokemon_tower_2f.description: The second floor. Shadows cling to the corners, and Channelers sway in eerie meditation among the graves.

pokemon_tower_3f.blocked_message: Two Channelers bar the stairs, deep in séance... and your RIVAL leans against the wall, waiting. (Defeat the Channelers and your rival to pass.)

pokemon_tower_3f.name: Pokémon Tower 3F
pokemon_tower_3f.description: The third floor. The air grows heavy and cold. A purified spot near the stairs hums with calm energy.

pokemon_tower_4f.blocked_message: Two Channelers bar the stairs, deep in séance... (Defeat Channelers on this floor to pass.)

route7.name: Route 7
route7.description: A short road between CELADON and SAFFRON. A stairway on the grass leads down into the underground path.

saffron_city.blocked_message: A thirsty guard blocks the SAFFRON gatehouse! (Give him a Fresh Water, Soda Pop, or Lemonade.)

underground_path.blocked_message: Two trainers are sparring in front of the tunnel stairs! (Defeat them to pass.)

route8.name: Route 8
route8.description: A winding road from LAVENDER to SAFFRON. A fenced patch of grass needs CUT to enter, and a stairway leads down to the underground path.

saffron_city.blocked_message: A thirsty guard blocks the SAFFRON gatehouse! (Give him a Fresh Water, Soda Pop, or Lemonade.)

underground_path.blocked_message: A Lass is picnicking right on the tunnel stairs and won't budge! (Defeat her to pass.)

underground_path.name: Underground Path
underground_path.description: A straight, well-lit tunnel running under SAFFRON CITY, connecting Route 7 in the west to Route 8 in the east.

celadon_city.name: Celadon City
celadon_city.description: CELADON CITY — The City of Rainbow Dreams. Kanto's largest city: a towering department store, a fragrant gym, and more neon than anywhere else.

celadon_dept_store.name: Celadon Department Store
celadon_dept_store.description: Kanto's grandest shop, all condensed onto one bustling floor: TMs, stones, vitamins, and vending-machine drinks.

celadon_mansion.name: Celadon Mansion
celadon_mansion.description: A luxury condominium in northwest Celadon. Game Freak's offices fill the front; a quiet rooftop room sits out back.

celadon_city_gym.name: Celadon City Gym
celadon_city_gym.description: A garden-like gym run by Erika, the Nature-Loving Princess. A maze of cuttable trees once guarded her (bring Cut for the full experience).

celadon_game_corner.name: Celadon Game Corner
celadon_game_corner.description: Celadon's infamous Game Corner. Slot machines hum, coins clatter, and a suspicious grunt loiters by a poster on the back wall...

explore_table.prompt: Behind the poster you find a hidden switch... Press it? Who wouldn't?
explore_table.success: Click! The floor rumbles and a hidden staircase grinds open, leading down into darkness. The Rocket Hideout is revealed!
explore_table.decline: You decide not to touch it. Some mysteries are best left alone... for now.

celadon_rocket_hideout.name: Rocket Hideout B1F
celadon_rocket_hideout.description: Team Rocket's secret base beneath the Game Corner. Fluorescent lights hum over rows of humming machinery. A stairwell leads deeper.

celadon_rocket_hideout_b2f.blocked_message: Two Rocket grunts bar the stairwell down. "No one gets past us!" (Defeat both grunts to descend.)

celadon_rocket_hideout_b2f.name: Rocket Hideout B2F
celadon_rocket_hideout_b2f.description: Deeper in the hideout. The air is thick with oil and static. Giovanni's office door looms at the far end, guarded.

celadon_rocket_hideout_office.blocked_message: Two grunts guard Giovanni's office door. "The boss sees no one!" (Defeat both grunts to enter.)

celadon_rocket_hideout_office.name: Giovanni's Office
celadon_rocket_hideout_office.description: A lavish office deep beneath Celadon. A Persian statue gleams in the corner. Giovanni himself rises from his desk as you enter.

saffron_city.name: Saffron City
saffron_city.description: The biggest city in Kanto, dominated by the towering Silph Co. headquarters. Sabrina's psychic gym warps challengers in circles, while a humble fighting dojo keeps the old ways alive next door.

saffron_city_gym.blocked_message: A Team Rocket grunt bars the Gym door. "Nobody gets in while Team Rocket runs this town!" (Defeat Giovanni at Silph Co. first.)

saffron_fighting_dojo.blocked_message: A Team Rocket grunt bars the dojo door. "The Fighting Dojo is closed!" (Defeat Giovanni at Silph Co. first.)

saffron_city_gym.name: Saffron City Gym
saffron_city_gym.description: Sabrina's gym: a disorienting maze of warp tiles. Psychics and channelers drift between rooms, waiting for challengers.

saffron_fighting_dojo.name: Fighting Dojo
saffron_fighting_dojo.description: A humble fighting dojo next to the grand psychic gym. Blackbelts train here under Karate Master Koichi, who rewards the strong with rare Pokémon.

silph_co_1f.name: Silph Co. 1F
silph_co_1f.description: The gleaming lobby of Silph Co., Kanto's premier Poké Ball manufacturer. The elevators to the upper floors are locked down -- something is wrong upstairs.

silph_co_2f.name: Silph Co. 2F
silph_co_2f.description: Silph Co. offices, now crawling with Team Rocket. Papers are scattered everywhere.

silph_co_3f.blocked_message: A Rocket grunt bars the stairwell. "This floor belongs to Team Rocket!" (Defeat the grunt to ascend.)

silph_co_3f.name: Silph Co. 3F
silph_co_3f.description: More ransacked offices. A Rocket patrols the stairwell; scientists loyal to Rocket linger by the lab equipment.

silph_co_4f.blocked_message: A Rocket grunt blocks the stairs up. "The stairs are closed!" (Defeat the grunt to ascend.)

silph_co_4f.name: Silph Co. 4F
silph_co_4f.description: A quieter floor -- and somewhere here, a Card Key that opens Silph's security doors.

silph_co_5f.blocked_message: A Rocket grunt bars the stairwell. "Nobody goes up without the boss's permission!" (Defeat the grunt to ascend.)

silph_co_5f.name: Silph Co. 5F
silph_co_5f.description: The executive floor. A security door seals the stairwell to the top -- it needs the Card Key. Giovanni's elite guard waits beyond.

silph_co_6f.blocked_message: A security door bars the stairs -- and a Rocket grunt stands guard! (Find the Card Key and defeat the grunt to ascend.)

silph_co_office.name: President's Office
silph_co_office.description: The Silph Co. president's lavish office. Giovanni himself stands between you and the trembling president.

route13.name: Route 13
route13.description: A winding path through a maze of fences, crawling with trainers. Ditto are said to hide in the tall grass here.

route14.blocked_message: A Biker roars up on his motorcycle, blocking the west path! "Toll's a battle, kid!" (Defeat the Biker to continue west.)

route14.name: Route 14
route14.description: A narrow trail heading south, dominated by Bird Keepers and Bikers. The grass here hides rare Ditto.

route15.blocked_message: A Bird Keeper and his Farfetch'd bar the southern trail! "None shall pass the master of birds!" (Defeat the Bird Keeper to continue south.)

route15.name: Route 15
route15.description: The final stretch west toward Fuchsia City. Trainers crowd both the high road and the low path.

fuchsia_city.blocked_message: A Bird Keeper's Dodrio blocks the road to Fuchsia City, kicking up dust! (Defeat the Bird Keeper to continue west.)

route16.name: Route 16
route16.description: A quiet road west of Celadon. A Snorlax sleeps soundly in the middle of the path, and a reclusive girl hides in a house past the trees.

route17.blocked_message: A sleeping Snorlax blocks the road west, and beyond it a guard stops all travelers without a Bicycle. (Wake the Snorlax with the Poké Flute and obtain a Bicycle to continue.)

explore_table.intro: The awakened Snorlax lumbers toward you, ready to battle!

route17.name: Route 17
route17.description: Cycling Road! A steep downhill slope packed with Bikers and Cue Balls. No bicycles, no entry.

route18.blocked_message: A Biker with a Muk and a Cue Ball with a Machoke block the bottom of the slope! "The road toll is TWO battles!" (Defeat them both to reach Route 18.)

route18.name: Route 18
route18.description: A short road east toward Fuchsia City. Bird Keepers patrol the fenced fields.

route17.blocked_message: The guard stops you. "Cycling Road is bicycles only!" (Obtain a Bicycle to enter.)

fuchsia_city.blocked_message: A Bird Keeper's Dodrio stands sentinel before Fuchsia City! "Not one step further!" (Defeat the Bird Keeper to continue east.)

fuchsia_city.name: Fuchsia City
fuchsia_city.description: A quiet city in southern Kanto, famous for the Safari Zone and Koga's ninja gym. The Warden's house sits to the east.

route19.blocked_message: The open sea is too rough to cross without a Pokemon that knows Surf. (Requires the Soul Badge)

fuchsia_city_gym.name: Fuchsia City Gym
fuchsia_city_gym.description: Koga's gym: a disorienting maze of invisible walls. Ninja trainers lurk behind every barrier.

fuchsia_warden_house.name: Warden's House
fuchsia_warden_house.description: The home of the Safari Zone Warden. He seems distressed about something.

safari_zone_center.name: Safari Zone Gate
safari_zone_center.description: The entrance building of Kanto's famous Safari Zone. Pay the entry fee to roam the three wild areas.

safari_zone_east.blocked_message: [DRAFT] The gate guard stops you. "Safari Zone entry is ¥500 -- talk to the attendant!"

safari_zone_north.blocked_message: [DRAFT] The gate guard stops you. "Safari Zone entry is ¥500 -- talk to the attendant!"

safari_zone_west.blocked_message: [DRAFT] The gate guard stops you. "Safari Zone entry is ¥500 -- talk to the attendant!"

safari_zone_east.name: Safari Zone: East Area
safari_zone_east.description: Tall grass stretches around a rocky ridge and a quiet lake. Rare Pokémon roam here.

safari_zone_north.name: Safari Zone: North Area
safari_zone_north.description: Rocky ridges overlook three small ponds. Something heavy moves in the tall grass.

safari_zone_west.name: Safari Zone: West Area
safari_zone_west.description: The deepest part of the park. A small house peeks through the trees to the west.

safari_secret_house.name: Secret House
safari_secret_house.description: A lonely house at the far end of the Safari Zone. Someone lives out here.

mt_moon_b2f.name: Mt. Moon - B2F
mt_moon_b2f.description: The deepest level of Mt. Moon. Few trainers venture this far down, but rare items glitter in the dark.

route19.name: Route 19
route19.description: A sparkling sea route running south from Fuchsia City to the Seafoam Islands. Swimmers and Beauties train in these waters.

route20.name: Route 20
route20.description: The eastern sea route, running from the Seafoam Islands toward Cinnabar Island. Strong currents and stronger trainers.

seafoam_1f.name: Seafoam Islands - 1F
seafoam_1f.description: The windswept entrance of the Seafoam Islands caverns. The cries of Zubat echo off the walls.

seafoam_2f.name: Seafoam Islands - B1F
seafoam_2f.description: Deeper into the islands, underground pools dot the cavern floor. Something valuable glints in the dark.

seafoam_3f.name: Seafoam Islands - B2F
seafoam_3f.description: The bottom of the Seafoam Islands. An unnatural chill hangs in the air, and frost creeps across the stone...

explore_table.intro: A legendary bird of ice regards you with piercing eyes... ARTICUNO!

cinnabar_island.name: Cinnabar Island
cinnabar_island.description: A volcanic island town. The Cinnabar Lab, the abandoned Pokemon Mansion, and Blaine's locked Gym dot the landscape.

cinnabar_island_gym.blocked_message: The Gym door is locked tight. A sign reads: 'Gym closed - key required.' (Find the Secret Key)

route21.blocked_message: The open sea is too rough to cross without a Pokemon that knows Surf. (Requires the Soul Badge)

cinnabar_island_gym.name: Cinnabar Island Gym
cinnabar_island_gym.description: Blaine's Gym: a quiz-show gauntlet of fire. Answer correctly or battle the trainer behind each door.

cinnabar_lab.name: Cinnabar Lab
cinnabar_lab.description: The Pokemon Lab. Scientists here can resurrect fossils - and two of them are eager to trade.

pokemon_mansion_1f.name: Pokemon Mansion - 1F
pokemon_mansion_1f.description: The abandoned mansion's entrance hall. Dusty statues line the walls, and something scurries in the shadows.

pokemon_mansion_2f.name: Pokemon Mansion - 2F
pokemon_mansion_2f.description: The mansion's second floor. A statue's hidden switch clicks somewhere in the dark...

pokemon_mansion_3f.name: Pokemon Mansion - 3F
pokemon_mansion_3f.description: The top floor. A balcony overlooks the floors below - the only way down is to jump.

pokemon_mansion_b1f.name: Pokemon Mansion - B1F
pokemon_mansion_b1f.description: The mansion's basement lab. Journals describe terrible experiments... and something glints in the final room.

route21.name: Route 21
route21.description: The northern sea route, stretching from Cinnabar Island to Pallet Town. A grassy islet south of Pallet hides Tangela.

pokemon_tower_6f.name: Pokemon Tower 6F
pokemon_tower_6f.description: The top of the tower. A restless ghost wails near the stairs, and TEAM ROCKET grunts loiter by an old man's side.

explore_table.intro: The SILPH SCOPE reveals the ghost... a furious MAROWAK, mother of CUBONE! It attacks!

pokemon_tower_4f.name: Pokemon Tower 4F
pokemon_tower_4f.description: The fourth floor. Channelers' chants echo off the walls, growing more frantic the higher you climb.

pokemon_tower_5f.blocked_message: Two Channelers bar the stairs, deep in seance... (Defeat Channelers on this floor to pass.)

pokemon_tower_5f.name: Pokemon Tower 5F
pokemon_tower_5f.description: The fifth floor. The veil between worlds feels thinnest here - ghostly wails drift up from below and down from above.

pokemon_tower_6f.blocked_message: Two Channelers bar the stairs, deep in seance... (Defeat Channelers on this floor to pass.)

silph_co_8f.name: Silph Co. 8F
silph_co_8f.description: The top floor corridor. Your rival leans against the president's office door, smirking. A grateful employee peeks out from a side room.

silph_co_office.blocked_message: Your rival blocks the office door, arms crossed. "Not a chance, loser!" (Defeat the scientist and your rival to enter.)

silph_co_6f.name: Silph Co. 6F
silph_co_6f.description: A maze of warp panels and locked storerooms. Rocket grunts patrol every corridor.

silph_co_7f.blocked_message: A security door bars the stairs -- and a Rocket grunt stands guard! (Find the Card Key and defeat the grunt to ascend.)

silph_co_7f.name: Silph Co. 7F
silph_co_7f.description: Research labs converted to Rocket staging grounds. The elevator hums - the top floors are close.

silph_co_8f.blocked_message: Two Rocket grunts block the stairwell! (Defeat the grunts on this floor to ascend.)

route23.name: Route 23
route23.description: The final stretch: a mountain path where only the strongest Trainers may pass. Surf across the water to reach Victory Road.

victory_road_1f.blocked_message: The League Guard bars the way. 'All 8 Kanto badges are required to enter Victory Road.'

victory_road_1f.name: Victory Road - 1F
victory_road_1f.description: The legendary gauntlet. Boulders, ladders, and the strongest wild Pokemon in Kanto guard the path to the Pokemon League.

victory_road_2f.name: Victory Road - 2F
victory_road_2f.description: Deeper into the mountain. A strange heat radiates from an isolated chamber...

explore_table.intro: A legendary bird of fire blocks the path, wings wreathed in flame... MOLTRES!

victory_road_3f.name: Victory Road - 3F
victory_road_3f.description: The final floor. Beyond the exit lies the Indigo Plateau - and the Elite Four.
